behavior: Recheck source-present names on the actual final writer prose after document line folding. Keep the existing early name, fact, citation, source-replacement and language gates; do not normalize actor typography or change source/human text.

For bounded explicit confirmation predicates, keep the same literal object and latest selected source sequence. A pending-to-confirmed claim requires a newer explicit assertion in the same meeting/run, with its exact source ID/revision in this paragraph's own citations. Supported quoted/conditional scopes, another object, notes and unselected sources cannot authorize it.

Keep supported quotations out of confirmation evidence across sentence stops, commas and line breaks, including escaped double quotes. Only ASCII alphanumeric neighbors classify ' or ’ as a word-internal apostrophe; the valid explicit update followed by it's ready stays eligible. This is a bounded quote grammar, not general linguistic scope resolution.

The confirmation view uses checked byte accumulation (262144 bytes total) and a total 64-frame/object ceiling. It adds no inference request and does not extend caption/ASR validation or infer cross-language object aliases.
